_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-08-07 · SkyGauge — the mode-7 bug you'd been chasing was already fixed (I measured rather than guessed), and your CPR/AED question now has a real number: 17,904 students at 106 colleges.
_status: Two things landed. First, the Sierra construction bug the last two sessions were chasing turned out to be fixed already — the data was always there, and the answer had started working a day earlier; I measured it properly and locked it down with a test so nobody re-chases it. Second, your CPR/AED question: 17,904 real students across 106 colleges have CPR-family credit recommendations — 42% of everyone in the system with any CPL recommendation. What Sierra still cannot tell you is what a college has DONE about them; that field isn't in anything we pull from MAP. There's now a script you run on your own machine that answers it without student data ever leaving your computer. One re-run and we'll have the applied/transcribed numbers too.

items.text: 📊 ONE RE-RUN AND WE HAVE THE REST — your export DOES have the column we needed (CPLStatusPlan, last of 29). The first run grabbed the wrong one and reported a 0% completion rate, which was false; that's fixed. Re-run the same command and we'll finally see, per credential, how many units are eligible, sitting in review, applied, and transcribed — which is what turns '17,904 students' into something a college can act on. Nothing leaves your machine but the totals.

📞 ASK MALONE FOR TWO THINGS — (1) the published name of the student-detail view; it isn't live yet (the API says 'not Valid'), and once it is, this becomes a daily refresh instead of a file that ages. (2) A stable per-student ID in it, ideally scrambled on their side — without one we can only count recommendations, not people, and any per-credential student total will be too high.

🔧 GIVE SIERRA THE 'WHAT HAPPENED' NUMBERS — she can say what credit exists but never what a college has acted on. The per-exhibit rollup now lines up with her exhibit list, so this is a join. ⚠ It writes to the shared table behind the widget on colleges' own pages — walk Sam through what changes and who sees it before touching it.

📬 SEVEN FEEDBACK REPORTS STILL NEED YOU — the inbox is cleaned up (our test robot's 31 rows are filtered out of the queue and the counts, and 4 reports whose fixes have shipped are marked done). The most useful of what's left: someone asked how many colleges have a CPL counsellor listed and Sierra couldn't answer, though she names them one at a time — that's a build, not a bug. Two are data gaps you already know about (student counts per certificate). The rest need an eye: Modesto showing 75 early-childhood credit recommendations when its landing page shows 4; Sierra reading the Fullerton catalogue in one answer and not the next; a bare thumbs-down on College of the Canyons; and the 17 July 'I don't have a college yet' report, which the student-portal work probably fixed but nobody has confirmed. ⚠ Please don't invite the MAP and CO teams until this has an owner — it's now CA-06 on the ⚖️ Governance tab, and that tab will show you the untriaged count live.

🔗 STILL UNCHECKED: THE LINK SIERRA GIVES STUDENTS — creditforbeingyou.org/main/student. I can't reach that domain from here, so it has never been confirmed and it's now in front of every student who asks. One click tells us; it's a one-line fix if it's wrong.

🔍 FINISH THE POACHING AUDIT — now that the 'never hide facts, never sell' line is live, re-run the five-part review (Sierra's rule text, her per-audience voices, the context builders, the live guidance rows in the 🧭 pane, and the sibling report generators) to confirm nothing else still tells her to stay quiet. SkyHero's audit was still running when that session ended and was never reported.

📚 REFRESH SIERRA'S EXHIBIT LIST — unchanged and still the biggest limit. Her copy covers 2,397 exhibits across 59 colleges; MAP has 123, and her college profiles were last refreshed 25 June. American River, LA Mission and West LA all give CPR credit and she cannot see them. Touches a shared table production reads, so walk Sam through the impact first.

🔢 WIRE MALONE'S STUDENT×CREDIT-RECOMMENDATION VIEW into the funding backlog builder once the view name lands. The 11.8MB export could not be read directly (the Drive connector caps at 10MB). Agreed columns are the 8 non-identifying ones; Sam wants small-group suppression at fewer than 10.

⚖️ FOUR GOVERNANCE ROWS NEED AN OWNER — DR-11 (who decides what Sierra tells the public — so far that's been you personally, four times in two days), CA-06 (Sierra feedback triage, which shows its own untriaged count live), OQ-07 (what must be true before inviting the MAP and CO teams) and OQ-08 (how new surfaces get onto the register at all). The ⚖️ tab now also shows a '🔎 Not on the register' strip — 15 things the daily scan found, six of them recurring jobs nobody listed. They're proposals; nothing gets added without you.

⚠️ HEADS-UP, NOT A BUG YOU NEED TO REPORT — 'Clear owner' does nothing on three cadences (the daily dashboard, the users sync, and the checkpoint loop), because those carry an owner in the register file itself rather than an assigned one. It'll look exactly like the two-click save bug coming back. It isn't, it's already written up, and it's on the list to fix.
